messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

message.content:
Below is a consolidated list of **long‑weekend** holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break (Saturday + Sunday + holiday).  

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Provinces/Regions that observe it | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-----------------------------------|---------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Monday | AB, BC, MB, ON, SK | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day | Friday | ON, BC, MB, SK | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | All provinces | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Apr 23** | St. George’s Day | Friday | BC | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | All provinces | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | All provinces | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | All provinces | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | All provinces | ✔ | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |

### Holidays that are statutory but **do not** create a natural long weekend in 2023

| Date | Holiday | Day | Provinces | Notes |
|------|---------|-----|-----------|-------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | All | Falls on Sunday; no natural long weekend |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Saturday | All | Falls on Saturday; no natural long weekend |
| Nov 11 | Remembrance Day | Saturday | All | Falls on Saturday; no natural long weekend |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | All | Falls on Tuesday; no natural long weekend |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to offer users the option to “take a day off” to extend a holiday that falls on a weekday (e.g., New Year’s Day on Sunday or Canada Day on Saturday), you can flag those dates as *“extendable”* and let users add a paid leave day to create a 4‑day weekend.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a province‑specific breakdown or additional details!
